title: Sahr Gborie (Radiographer) — Interim Order Application
text:
Order:
ORDER: The Registrar is directed to suspend the registration of Sahr Gborie on an interim basis for a period of 12 months.

Notes:
This order will be reviewed by the Committee no later than 17 June 2026 or earlier if new evidence which is relevant to the Order becomes available after it was made.

Right to Apply to the Court
Under Article 31(12) of the Health Professions Order 2001, you may apply to the appropriate court to terminate the order.
court: Health and Care Professions Tribunal Service
